settings.heading: Shipping Policy
settings.body:
Orders are processed after payment confirmation. Delivery times shown on product pages or checkout are estimates and may vary by supplier, destination, carrier, and inventory availability.

If an order cannot ship within the stated timeframe, we will notify the customer and provide available options, which may include waiting for the delayed shipment or canceling for a refund.

Customers are responsible for entering accurate shipping information. Contact us quickly if an address needs to be corrected.

Do not publish this template until your actual processing times, carrier details, shipping regions, and supplier fulfillment timeframes are added.
